title: Pip Did It
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds h, b, f, ff
note_for_grown_ups: A small, true moment of pride — Pip keeps trying rather than giving up. Ask your child about a time they kept trying at something small until it worked.

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing beside a large heavy plant pot by a garden gate.

pages.text: The pot is big. Pip is sad.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pushing weakly at the big pot, unable to move it, looking discouraged.
Pip resting for a moment beside the pot, then standing back up to try again.
Pip the sparrow straining hard against the pot, feathers puffed out with effort.
Pip the sparrow finally tipping the big pot upright by himself, triumphant.
Pip the sparrow standing proudly next to the upright pot, smiling.

pages.text: Pip did it! Pip has fun.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping happily around the pot by the garden gate, delighted with himself.
